title: GameIndex Plugin Descriptor
description: Schema for the object passed to definePlugin() in a GameIndex search plugin. The `search` member is a live JavaScript function and therefore cannot be represented in JSON Schema; it is required by the runtime but omitted from `required` here so the serializable manifest can be validated on its own.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier for the plugin.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the UI.

author.description: Author or maintainer of the plugin.

description.description: One-line summary of what the plugin searches.

platformCategory.description: Broad platform class this plugin covers. Unknown values are normalised to "pc" by the host.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts the plugin is allowed to contact when the host enforces an egress allow-list.

rateLimitMs.description: Minimum delay between outbound requests, in milliseconds.

cacheTtlSecs.description: How long search results may be cached, in seconds.

icon.description: Icon URL or built-in icon name for the Sources list.

capabilities.description: Optional capability flags declared by the plugin.

config.description: Optional user-configurable settings, described as a JSON-Schema-like object. The host renders a form from it and passes the resolved values to search(query, config).

search.description: The search entry point: a JavaScript function `search(query, config) -> Array`. Required by the runtime, but not representable in JSON Schema.
